nom: COSRX The Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Bounce Cream

avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and I don't think this one is it for me. I really want to like it. But I find it reddens my skin more. Also, the next day my face was pretty dry and lacking moisture. But it might do wonders for others. Especially if you don't have sensitive skin.
I'm 43 and this stuff makes my skin glowy and smoothed out the fine lines on my forehead so im sold

Absolutely love this moisturizer! I pair it with the serum and my skin feels great, so soft and moisturizing but not too heavy. My complexion is looking better too. I'll highly recommend the moisturizer and matching serum.
I absolutely LOVE the new Cosrx Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Bouncy cream. My skin and pores look amazing.

This gel moisturizer is lightweight and doesn't cause any issues for my skin. I haven't noticed a major difference in pore size or other improvements but perhaps it needs more time. (It's only been a couple weeks)

I like this cream. It's very light weight but moisturizes really nicely and perfect for hot weather days because it's light gel like consistency. It's cooling and refreshing and i love to use it in the morning. It leaves a nice dewy glow on the skin and absorbs easily.

I have used The Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Bounce Cream daily since I received it - about 2 weeks. I can definitely tell a difference in my skin, it is smoother, my pores tighter, and feels so hydrated without feeling greasy. Definitely a product that will be staying in my routine.

I've used this cream just a few days now but it is pleasant to use. The gel is lightweight and smoothing over my pores, as well as gentle on my sensitive skin. I appreciate that there is no odor and feels light for the warmer summer weather that is already upon us. It plays well under my sunblock and does not causing pilling.
This cream is light and hydrating. Smooth on the face and calms skin down. The color is really cool and the blue does not stain on clothing. It has ceramides in it. Love it!!

This cream is amazing. I have oily, sensitive skin and have not experienced any reaction after using it. It doesn't make my skin oily like some moisturizers do, and when I use it at night, I wake up to such soft skin! I haven't really noticed any effect on my pores, but maybe after using it longer I will see a difference. That won't stop me from continuing to buy this.

This cream, combined with the bakuchiol + peptide serum, has been great for my skin. It's more like a gel moisturizer than a thick cream so I do have to put another moisturizer on after it. I have combo/sensitive skin with rosacea and this didn't cause any negative effects for me.

COSRX The Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Bounce Cream is amazing! I've been using this product for approximately one week and already I can see a visible difference in the texture firmness plumpness hydration glass skin finish. I have received multiple compliments from women and men about my skin glowing and asking me what products am I using. My skin feels hydrated moisturized full, like plump, dense full youthful. The finish is glass skin. The texture is refined. The quality the product is amazing. Its silky light smooth like a water-based rich, hydrating cream. The natural blue color is elegant. The natural blue color is elegant and it is fragrance free.

I'm absolutely love the new COSRX Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Bounce Cream! Since I use the COSRX Vitamin C 23 Serum every morning, I've been using this cream exclusively at night, especially on my retinol nights. After two weeks, I can honestly say I love the results. The formula feels rich and nourishing without being heavy, and the combination of copper peptides and bakuchiol leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft, hydrated, and plump by morning. I wake up with smoother, bouncier skin every time I use it. This has quickly become a go to in my nighttime routine and is a fantastic option for early anti-aging care.

I did not expect to like this cream so much! It is SUPER lightweight, with more of a gel texture. It melts into your skin very easily and is not sticky whatsoever. You can use it day or night and with any other skincare products. That makes it a holy grail for me and knowing I'm protecting my skin while also improving it is everything!
My skin texture has improved, it has more life to it. Not so dull. The cream feels refreshing on your skin. My pores are less noticeable. Gives you a glass look.

Wow, this is my new daily face cream! I was using the hyaluronic acid cream daily at bedtime but this beats that. My skin is so soft and plump looking. Pores are tiny. The cream arrived while I was on vacation so when I got home, I was excited to try it to see if it would help with the dryness of being in the sun for 10 days. My skin was healed in 2 days!! Highly recommend.
Very lightweight, I loved the texture it melts into your skin.
My skin has felt and looked smoother. It's brighter and more plump. I use this daily morning and at night. Definitely a staple in my beauty routine!
This is such a wonderful summer moisturizer!! It absorbs well, isn't sticky, and makes my face glow :star2:

While I haven't been using this product long enough to be able to attest to all of the claimed benefits, I like what The Blue Bounce Cream is doing for my skin so far. I have mainly been using this at night and when I wake up in the morning my skin feels amazing. Instead of oily it's soft and hydrated. I feel like my pores aren't as visible and my skin just feels taken care of. The cream itself is light, absorbs nicely without leaving sheen or stickiness and a dime size amount is all I need. I'm excited to see what the results are after longer use!
So far so good. Ive been using this cream for two weeks and my pores seem minimized, making my skin look great. I would highly recommend for more plump soft looking skin

The Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Bounce Cream is fabulous. It goes on smoothly and sits well on my skin. I noticed that my pores appear smaller. I have oily skin and my skin produces a lot of oil. I like this cream because it is not heavy or gummy. The texture has a nice balance that does not cause my skin to feel oily. It feels soft and smooth.

I've only been using this for a few days, but I'm loving it! It's a really lightweight cream, I think it'll be perfect for summer time. I've not noticed any breakouts since starting it, and it makes my skin so smooth! I did receive this for free in exchange for a review.

avis.titre: COSRX really nailed the formula on this one
avis.texte: The Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Bounce Cream is a fragrance-free, cushiony moisturizer that feels a bit richer than their Oil-free Ultra-Moisturizing Lotion with Birch Sap—about 1. 5 x thicker, but without crossing into heavy or greasy territory. Despite the thicker texture, it absorbs cleanly and doesn't leave any sticky residue, which is a huge win if you like a smooth, non-tacky finish.One thing I appreciate is how a little goes a long way. You don't need much to cover your whole face and neck, so the jar lasts longer than you'll expect. It also has a surprisingly gentle feel: even if you apply it over small cuts or irritated spots, it doesn't sting, which makes it easy to use alongside actives or on compromised skin days.My only gripe is the packaging. It comes in a jar with no spatula included, which feels like a miss for a product at this tier. Personally, I'll prefer a pump-style container for hygiene and convenience, especially for daily use.Overall, it's a well-formulated, soothing moisturizer with a plush texture and zero irritation-just held back slightly by packaging that could be more user-friendly.

I was a little bit nervous about the color of the cream at first but when I tried it all my fears melted away. And so did my dry skin I loved it it literally shrink my pores to Invisible level I Will definitely be adding this to my routine

I'm usually skeptical of new skin care, but this cream exceeded my expectations. My skin feel softer, smooth and deeply hydrated without feeling heavy. It absorbs quickly & gives a glow and it makes my skin feel luxurious as if I just came out of the spa. My pores are non existent! LOVEEEE
COSRX The Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Bounce Cream is lightweight, hydrating, and non-greasy. It absorbs quickly, leaves my skin soft and plump, and feels comfortable all day.
This cream is EVERYTHING. It is gentle but powerful. No greasy feeling, no irritation, just results. I am glowing without redness or purging. Combined with the serum, it's the perfect anti-aging duo!

I love this new cream! I have been using it with the blue peptide serum and my face looks and feels amazing. I definitely recommend trying this. My face has become more sensitive lately, and this cream has not caused any reactions or discomfort. I will absolutely be repurchasing this.

I've used this cream on my face at night and in the morning as my NEW daily routine. Honestly my face feels as if it's been moisturized by Vaseline without the sticky oily look! I usually would experience some sort of dryness on my face by the end of the day but not with this product. It feels so light and soft like it's a gel but it's very creamy and moisturizing on the face.

cosrx never misses. i was a little hesitant just because it is in a jar and not a squeeze bottle but the way this made my skin feel i truly do not mind. it leaves a silky smooth feeling behind that makes skin look so radiant after first use.

Came in beautiful packaging and is a vibrant color. I normally use the COSRX AC moisturizer so I was worried about trying this one because I thought it would cause breakouts??But I was pleasantly surprised! I've noticed a visible difference in the appearance of my skin as well as as an evening of redness on my cheeks and nose. I definitely recommend this to anyone who wants to try a new moisturizer, but is worried about acne! Just for reference, I have fairly sensitive skin as well as an oily T-zone, and this moisturizer keeps me looking dewey without looking oily!

avis.titre: Given product for free in exchange for honest review
avis.texte: I love this cream! I had recently purchased and started using the blue peptide serum, which was already great. But paired with the blue peptide cream is even more amazing. The cream is a nice texture and easily absorbed. Does not pill under makeup. Gives the skin a really great glow. And the hydration/glow lasts all day/night. If you pair the 6 peptide booster, the blue peptide serum, and the blue peptide cream, your skin will absolutely thank you <3 I attached a photo of my skin after waking up in the morning before cleansing (after using the blue peptide serum and cream the night before), and also a photo immediately after using the blue peptide duo in my morning routine.

avis.titre: Skin cell turnover without the irritation
avis.texte: At 46 years old, I have aging skin that has gone from combination to dry / sensitive. I have used retinol in the past, but it causes my skin to become irritated, flaky, and bright red like a sun burn. This moisturizer gives my skin a glow without the harsh irritation. After only 3 days of using this I have noticed a difference in the glow of my skin. I haven't noticed a change in fine lines or texture yet, but it's only been 3 days. There is a little redness that is happening from the cell turnover, but not as bad compared to retinols I've used in the past. As a gel moisturizer, it's not as moisturizing as I would like for my skin type so I layered it with Cosrx Hyaluronic Acid Intensive Cream. Hopefully there will be a cream version in the future. I haven't seen a difference in fine lines or texture yet, but it's only been 3 days and time will tell. I highly recommend this product if you are looking for an alternative to retinol. Just note that if you have dry skin, you might want to layer it with a heavier face cream.

avis.titre: The hydration my skin has desperately looking for
avis.texte: I just got this cream and love the way it feels it has a cooling effect, glides on like gel, but it has a creamy consistency. Very subtle aroma it leaves your skin feeling glowy and super hydrated like bouncy! I love to apply after work for the cooling effect

I really needed cream and I got this blue peptide cream. It's light weight formula, really calming on the skin and just a pea size is enough to cover whole face and neck. I really enjoy the skin care time now with this cream and excited for my skin to grow and pores to be healthy.
